We need to identify the crime under Chinese law. The facts: falsifying customs import tax payment documents, false declaration to tax bureau to claim tax deduction. This is likely "虚开发票罪" (crime of issuing false invoices) or "骗取出口退税罪"? Actually they are using false customs import tax payment certificates to claim tax deduction. This is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" maybe. But they used customs import tax payment book (缴款书) to claim input tax deduction. That is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (false invoice issuance) or "骗取税款罪" (tax evasion). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 205: "虚开增值税专用发票罪" includes using伪造的发票、收据等骗取税款. Also article 201: "偷税漏税罪". But here they falsify customs documents to claim input tax deduction, which is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (false invoice issuance). Also could be "骗取出口退税罪"? Not export. So answer: "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Provide in format.
